text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Haa... This year's Takarazuka Kinen is... 
being held... in Kyoto...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It hasn't been long since the Tenno Sho 
(Spring)... and the track is rough! That 
means this race is going to take serious 
power...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"...Ryan-oneesama. Training at the gym 
even on your days off, I see~"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Bright! Yeah, the main event is starting 
soon!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
There's no guarantee that accumulated 
effort will be rewarded. Even so, in order 
to win, effort is an absolute necessity.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"So come watch me, Bright. Together with 
Dober."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
—I'll have a present ready for all of you 
at the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Together, the two of us will bear 
witness to the light gifted by dear 
sister. We shall make it our sustenance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yeah, thank you. ......

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...If I get your hopes up and end up 
losing, sorry in advance, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my~? Onee-sama, you really are quite 
the joker~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The day of the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Spectator in a Suit
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. What time is Ines Fujin's race 
scheduled for today?

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Manager
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's the main race, so it starts 
just after 15:30! Wait, are you a fan of 
Fuu?

text_block_list.name: Spectator in a Suit
text_block_list.text:
Well... yes. I would dearly love to cheer 
for you at an actual racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Spectator in a Suit
text_block_list.text:
"...Actually, she's my subordinate. She 
works part-time in our flyer distribution 
department."

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Manager
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, is that true!? To tell the truth, so 
are we!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, no way?! The manager from my shift 
is hitting it off with the store owner?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hitting it off right at the venue and 
cheering together in the stands... Can 
something like that really happen...!?
choice_data_list:
I really appreciate you coming all the way 
to Kyoto.
Thanks for coming all the way to Kyoto.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...! First off, I'm just so surprised 
you both came to cheer for me...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(—But if those two are also coming to 
dream with me...)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...I really want to live up to their 
expectations.
choice_data_list:
Turn everyone's support into strength and 
do your best!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah! You're right! Of course I'll go do 
that!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Inhaaaale... Whew...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (Both Ryan and McQueen are running today.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (Still, even I—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOAAAAAAAHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...! Here it comes...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: McQueeeeen!! Lady Ryaaaan!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(I don't even need to look closely to 
tell. Ryan-chan's muscle tone... She's 
grown another level since the Tenno Sho 
(Spring).)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(Besides, it's not just my body that's in 
top condition. My concentration too—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
McQueen isn't the only one in the Mejiro 
family! I'll make sure to show everyone 
that Mejiro Ryan is here too, right at the 
Takarazuka Kinen!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...*Gulp*.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(Besides, it's not just my body that's in 
top condition. My concentration too—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
McQueen isn't the only one in the Mejiro 
family! I'll make sure to show everyone 
that Mejiro Ryan is here too, at the 
Takarazuka Kinen as well!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...*Gulp*.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ah, Ines! About today's match...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...! Fufu, you're right.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
First, a handshake. ...I'm not backing 
down, you know.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Nice to meet you too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two gripped each other's hands firmly. 
And thus, the Takarazuka Kinen was about 
to get underway—!
